program.name: Gentle Flow
program.subject: Gentle / low impact
program.blurb: Gentle guided movement: simple standing poses one day, easy floor stretches the next.
program.about: Gentle, guided movement for any age or ability. One day is simple standing poses and slow marching, holding a chair if you like; the other is easy floor stretches for the back and hips. The voice walks you through everything and nothing is rushed. Levels II and III hold each pose a little longer.
